reviews.review_text:
Cruiser59554659834
Frankfurt, Germany3 contributions
1
It's good, you should try it
May 2024 • Friends
I visited Saigon as a tourist for 2 months and as a vegetarian head chef from Germany, I was on the lookout for a good vegetarian spot and local vegan cuisine. I found a memorable place, though it was difficult to categorize as good or not.

I came across this restaurant on my first day in town and ended up trying a variety of dishes from breakfast to dinner. I remember seeing pictures of the head chef on Google and assuming that he was around 23-24 years old, wearing a white chef jacket. If you happen to come across this, this message is for you, young man.
I've tried some of the dishes on the menu. Some were great while others were not. Here's my assessment:

The good:
The Pad Thai, The Stew Mushroom, and the Salad with the jello flower are amazing! These are your Holy Trinity. Worth every penny. I'd love to have your recipes for those.

The average:
The avocado "banh mi" is fresh but lacks flavor. I suggest grilling the pineapple a little longer to release its natural sweetness. The "Pho" is neither outstanding nor bad. The Mustard green rolls' peanut sauce is good but the filling is bland.

The stay-away items:
The Tropical salad is extremely underwhelming. It lacks variety and is quite dull. How can you come from the most beautiful salad bowl I've ever seen to a boring old man plate?
The VEGAN pork ribs were kind of sad. I've had better at local vegan stalls.
The vegan "Mapo tofu" was definitely a stay-away.

Overall, the service is good, the waiter named Huong is super friendly, and the atmosphere deserves a 9 out of 10. It's worth a visit.

Chef Howard Langard, greetings from Germany.
